text:
Alice M: Heads up — I'm proposing an audit-event schema "slimming" to remove long-deprecated fields (actor.email, request_id_v1) and add a few contextual fields: actor.role, requestor_ip, encryption.kms_key_id. Need to align on versioning, migration plan, and customer-facing validation. :thinking_face:

Bob S: +1 on a plan. My take: treat removals as a breaking change => major version (v2). Additive fields can be minor. Consumers should opt into v2 via header/query param or feature-flag so we can do a staged rollout.

Carlos R: We already have the feature flag infra. I suggest an "audit_schema_v2" flag that flips runtime shims. For compatibility we can serve both shapes simultaneously for a grace period and log consumer parse failures. :eyes:﻿

Dana L: KMS note — if we surface encryption.kms_key_id we must ensure RBAC prevents key-id exfiltration to support customers who consider key metadata sensitive. Also update PII-redaction to handle any new fields before storage/exports.

Erin K: Customer validation: we should publish a validator script + a small adapter (npm/pypi) that maps old->new and validates payloads. Run it against top 20 customers with opt-in canary. Provide a test harness: sample events, schema diffs, and migration checklist.

Frank T: Suggested shim snippet for adapters (very small):
```
// pseudo
function shimToV2(event) {
  if (!event.actor) return event;
  // map deprecated email -> identifier if present
  if (event.actor.email && !event.actor.identifier) {
    event.actor.identifier = event.actor.email;
    delete event.actor.email; // removal handled at gateway
  }
  // add role placeholder if missing
  event.actor.role = event.actor.role || 'unknown';
  return event;
}
```
Keep shims as opt-in in the SDKs so internal services can opt-in early.

Alice M: Good. Let's also require schema version in the root envelope: e.g., "audit_schema_version": "1". That way consumers can route parsing easily. For the rollout: docs + adapters + 8-week dual-write window then hard cut with a major release notice.

Bob S: Minor ops detail: instrument the gateway to emit a metric when requests include removed fields — helps track who still sends them. Create an alert if >1% of traffic still contains removed fields after 4 weeks.

Carlos R: I'll add gateway metric and a lightweight reject mode behind a flag (reject-if-header-x-request-v2=true) for internal load-testing.

Dana L: For KMS integration, add a column in the audit-enrichment job to normalize kms_key_id to a hashed token when emitting to S3 logs, with access to plaintext token via secure console only. I'll draft RBAC rules.

Erin K: I'll own the customer outreach: docs, migration guide, and invite top-20 integrators to a private beta. Also produce a CSV of impacted webhook consumers for support.

Frank T: I'll prepare SDK adapter PRs (python/node/go) and the shim tests. I recommend adding unit tests that simulate parsing both v1 and v2 envelopes.

audit-bot: security: static-scan completed for adapter code - 2 low findings (infoleak warnings) assigned to Frank T.

Alice M: Action items summary:
- Carlos: gateway metrics + feature flag config (ETA 3d)
- Frank: adapter + shim PRs + tests (ETA 1w)
- Erin: docs, validator script, customer beta list (ETA 1w)
- Dana: KMS RBAC draft + redaction plan (ETA 5d)
- Bob: rollout SLO/alert thresholds and major-version comms (ETA 2d)
- Alice: migration playbook + timeline (I'll draft by EOD)

Anyone object to the 8-week dual-write window and hard cut after comms?

Bob S: sounds fine. :thumbsup:﻿

Carlos R: fine by me.

Dana L: fine, but request we add a rollback playbook — include steps to re-enable v1-only parsing in 30m.

Alice M: Yep will include rollback steps. I'll post the draft migration playbook link here when ready: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit-schema-migration (draft).

Erin K: Thanks — I'll sync with Legal for customer notice wording.

Frank T: I'll kick off the initial PRs and tag reviewers.

Alice M: Great work team — will follow up with a short meeting invite for tomorrow to finalize scope. :calendar:
